operation_details.item: The user has chronic migraine; advice should avoid encouraging sleep deprivation and should respect the user's clinician's treatment plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! I saw you have a demanding conference week coming up. How can I help you plan for it?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'm trying to map out a productive schedule. There are so many sessions, plus a paper deadline, and I want to stay sharp.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds intense. It might help to block out sessions with buffer time for transitions and meals. Are there any health considerations I should keep in mind?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes — I have chronic migraine, so advice should not encourage sleep deprivation and should respect my clinician's treatment plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I won't suggest anything that conflicts with your clinician's plan, and I'll prioritize sleep and rest. Would you like me to draft a conference-day template?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That would be great. I need to fit keynotes, my own talk, and maybe some networking without overloading myself.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For each day, I'd suggest a fixed sleep window of at least seven to eight hours, a twenty-minute break between sessions, and a longer lunch. Also, keep your prescribed treatment times as fixed blocks in the schedule.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good. My talk is on Thursday, so I want extra prep time that morning to feel ready.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: On Thursday, maybe schedule a quiet ninety-minute prep block before your talk, with a short walk or some stretching after to reduce tension. Avoid back-to-back meetings immediately before you present.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: What about evenings? There are receptions, but I don't want to overdo it.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Receptions can be draining. Maybe attend only the ones that matter most, set a leave-by time for yourself, and keep the rest of the evening unstructured. That supports a consistent wind-down.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. I'll also keep my usual medication schedule as planned and not skip doses even if things get busy.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds wise. Following your clinician's plan is the most important thing. Would you like a printable schedule template with these buffers built in?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, please. And maybe add a reminder to hydrate — dehydration can be a trigger for me.
